scripts.dist: DIST="$HOME/Desktop/行者的星球-网页发布包" && rm -rf "$DIST" "${DIST}.zip" && mkdir -p "$DIST/assets" && cp index.html styles.css sw.js manifest.webmanifest "$DIST/" && cp -R js "$DIST/js" && cp -R vendor "$DIST/vendor" && cp -R assets/postcards "$DIST/assets/postcards" && cp assets/*.jpg assets/*.png "$DIST/assets/" && (cd "$DIST" && zip -rq "${DIST}.zip" .) && echo "Published clean bundle to $DIST"
